/description.summary: A restrained banker's deck: black Arial on white, a deep blue (113D63) full-width rule under the title and a blue block at the left edge on every page, light grey panels for sensitivity grids, the bank name in blue at the foot, one message per page in a 24pt plain title.
/description.typography: Arial throughout; 24pt regular titles that run to two lines when needed, 12pt body in square-bullet lists, bold 12pt for emphasis inside a sentence, 10pt for notes and sources. No italics, no caps except short labels.
/description.color: White pages, black text; deep blue for structure (rule, left block, label boxes, header fills) and for the footer name; light grey for panel fills and secondary bars; red appears once as a highlight line and is not a palette colour.
/description.layout: A consistent left margin of 0.42in; title band at the top; content either one full-width text block or a label column beside explanatory bullets; exhibits sit right with text left; generous bottom margin above the footer rule.
/description.tables: Flat grids: blue header band with white bold text, thin grey interior rules, no outer border, figures right-aligned, labels left.
/description.imagery: Pasted exhibits (screenshots of models) spanning the content width, no frames or shadows.
/description.motifs: The top rule and the left block are the page signature; label boxes are solid blue rectangles with white text; nothing is rounded, nothing has an effect.
not_seen: colour bars that are not the top rule or left block
/description.charts: Flat deep-blue bars with the figure at the bar end, no gridlines, no value axis where labels carry the figures; source line under the exhibit (slide 9).

/derivation_rules: Extend the palette by stepping the deep blue towards the grey: 113D63 -> 5E7C9E -> CCD1D7; never introduce a new hue.
New text roles take a size from the ladder 10 / 12 / 15 / 19 / 24; weight 700 only for emphasis, h2 and table headers.
Any new component is drawn flat with rect geometry, blue header treatment and grey panels, ruled with 0.5pt grey lines.

/color/roles/color.accent2.why: the reference's deep-blue swatch 17-61-99 on the master; the draft observes the same hex as color.rule (the top rule and left block)

/color/roles/color.positive.why: the reference marks the favourable case in its own deep blue (slide 12 recommendation chevrons); no green is ever used, so positive takes the structural blue

/color/roles/color.negative.why: the only saturated non-blue in the deck: the red highlight outline on slides 7, 8 and 10 that flags the adverse figure
